note: Detection works (P1: 92% of 51 corpus nets have chain score S >= 10x chance; their inits <= 0.016). Recovery of the shared subspace is partial (P2: median capture 0.45 undecayed n=11, 0.77 decayed n=38). Function-preserving extraction from weights alone fails (P3 0/54, P4 -0.05 vs I1; P5 not evaluable). One simple estimator tested (top-16 singular subspaces per layer, projector-sum eigenspace); others untested. Crash note: first full run died at the first 512-wide net (hard-coded width) and was rerun after making the script width-generic; no result was seen before the fix.
